_: Writing order of each letter, as waypoints in the frame of the glyph's ink box (x 0 at the left edge to 1 at the right, y 0 at the top to 1 at the bottom). Each stroke is a list of waypoints the pen passes in order; derive-strokes.mjs snaps them to the thinned glyph, joins them along it, pulls a stroke's first and last waypoint to the skeleton's end where one is near, then extends each end to the ink's edge. Dots are found by themselves (`taps` says how many) and tapped lower-first, right-first; a letter in `strokeAll` has no dots (the sign in ك is a small hamza, traced). The orders are the author's (2026-10-25): ج ح خ from the LEFT of the head bar, right along it, then down the curve; ص ض from the loop's bottom-left up and round the loop to the tooth, then down the bowl, one stroke; ط ظ the loop from its left end, then the stem top to bottom; ع غ from the head's right tip, one stroke; ف ق from the loop's bottom-right round the loop and on, one stroke; م from the head's top-left; هـ from the loop's top, one stroke; و from the loop's right, round to the left and up, then the tail; ى one stroke without coming back; ء the head then the whole base. These are the DEFAULTS: a template the teacher draws himself on the card (admin, 'Teach the strokes') replaces a letter's at runtime and is pulled into strokes.json by pull-cloud.mjs.
